craft_notes: Sthāyin: taste-block apex (literal, per lore/roche — never bowdlerized). Sanskrit: lehanāmanthanākoṭaiḥ...ānandasamplavaḥ → L4 keeps licking-churning-pounding whole + even-when-power-absent clause. Rows: row 2 (memory→flood may be). Close: may be (optative — flood permitted, not urged). Rejected: 'embracing' for lehanā — killed: licking kept (taste-method); softening strīsukha — killed: woman-bliss kept (text's word).

lines: Licking, churning, pounding's apex — woman-bliss from
